parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the bonding in benzene, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_6$.

Your answer should include:

• the hybridisation of the six carbon atoms
• the types of bond between the carbon atoms
• the orbitals that overlap to produce the bonds between the carbon atoms
• the type of bond between the carbon atoms and the hydrogen atoms
• the orbitals that overlap to produce the bonds between the carbon atoms and the hydrogen atoms.

parts.text: Describe the reagents and conditions required for step 1 in Fig. 9.1.

parts.text:
In step 1 of Fig. 9.1 benzene reacts with $^+\text{CH}_3$.

Complete Fig. 9.2 to show the mechanism for this reaction, including:

• the movement of electron pairs using curly arrows
• the structure of the intermediate involved.
